methodology.cache_probe: separate fresh result read twice; excluded from warmup/measured summaries
methodology.comparison: queue batch wall time and per-case batch throughput differ from serial/queued case latency; GPU overlap unproven without trace
methodology.compression: full padded buffer transferred; meaningful prefix copied to bytes after metadata check; stdlib validation outside guard
methodology.cpu: thread_time_ns for calling thread; wall times include waiting
methodology.depth2pinned: at most two independent GPU results; enqueue next codec before consuming prior; metadata before each pinned output copy
methodology.environment: no affinity or numerical-thread environment forced
methodology.faults: minor/major_faults are process-wide deltas and can include concurrent JAX work; thread fault deltas separately recorded when supported
methodology.fresh_results: new JIT result per case; one resident immutable input per operation
methodology.npinned: serial completed codec, then device_put to SingleDeviceSharding(memory_kind=pinned_host), block and np.asarray
methodology.numpy: serial completed codec, then np.asarray of full fresh result
methodology.order: fixed operation/mode order, separately warmed; allocation/cache/device-state effects remain possible
methodology.scope: diagnostic resident codec + host-array + bytes + independent validation; no CPU comparison
